payload.title: Add selected-project Export with full settings and Render Queue/direct modes
acceptance: Selected one/multiple projects expose Export beside Copy in All projects.
Dialog offers the same format, resolution, encoding, quality and audio controls as editor export, plus selected scene per project.
Supports direct export and adding frozen saved project snapshots to Render Queue without acquiring source editor write ownership.
Reuses canonical export policy/capture and existing renderer; selection and projects remain intact.
Production build/deploy and live single/multiple-project exports verified on disposable projects.
